name: SPY bull call spread: $10 wide, 4.95 debit, 2 monthly expirations
note: Your routine: every third Friday, buy the SPY call spread that costs 4.95 ($10 wide, expiring on the monthly expiration two months out), only while SPY is above its 200-day average. Close at 9.90 (9.50 in dividend months) or at expiry. Priced with Black-Scholes using the VIX; payoff at expiry exact.
